description.fr-FR: Suite des lettres diverses de Bossuet, de 1695 à sa mort : la querelle de la comédie avec le P. Caffaro, les lettres sur les nouveaux convertis avec l’évêque de Mirepoix et M. de Basville, les lettres à Milord Perth, à Louvain, au pape Clément XI. Édition Lachat (1864), tome XXVII.
description.en-US: The continuation of Bossuet’s miscellaneous letters, from 1695 to his death: the dispute over the theatre with Father Caffaro, the letters on the new converts with the Bishop of Mirepoix and M. de Basville, the letters to Lord Perth, to Louvain and to Pope Clement XI. Lachat edition (1864), volume XXVII.
description.pt-BR: Continuação das cartas diversas de Bossuet, de 1695 até a sua morte: a querela do teatro com o pe. Caffaro, as cartas sobre os novos convertidos com o bispo de Mirepoix e o sr. de Basville, as cartas a Lord Perth, a Lovaina e ao papa Clemente XI. Edição Lachat (1864), tomo XXVII.

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Bossuet, éd. F. Lachat, Paris, Vivès, 1862-1866, in the typed transcription of the Abbaye Saint-Benoît de Port-Valais (Wayback Machine)
sources.description: Typed transcription of volume XXVII, pages 001 and 003-012 (Lettres diverses, suite). The transcription loses the œ ligature; it is restored by a dictionary pass (ambiguous forms such as sœur/sur, mœurs/murs, vœu/vu decided from the Lachat OCR). Page-bottom notes of the Lachat edition are kept as footnotes.
sources.tierEvidence: Bossuet died in 1704; Lachat 1862-66 is public domain.
